title: Musim Tengkujuh
subject: a Terengganu fisherman's wife weaving songket at her loom through the monsoon while her husband, boat beached, mends the same net beside her
caption: Malay court gamelan song in the Terengganu gamelan Melayu tradition, adapted for voice. A keromong of small kettle-gongs playing a steady interlocking melody in a five-note gamelan tuning; a wooden gambang running soft quick patterns; saron kecil and saron besar metallophones carrying the main melody in slow even strokes; a gendang hand drum leading every change of tempo; kenong and a pair of large hanging gongs marking the end of each cycle. Warm and roomy like a wooden palace hall, the metallophones forward and ringing, the gongs deep and long, the voice close and plain. A soft, restrained female voice in a low-middle register, unornamented and unhurried, placed over the gong cycles. 72 BPM, D minor. Tender, unhurried and content. No drum kit, no electric bass, no piano, no pop strings or ballad chords, no Balinese gong kebyar shimmer, no autotune, no melismatic runs.
lyrics:
[Intro - saron melody and one gong stroke]

[Verse 1]
Bulan dua belas, laut dah tutup
Perahu abang naik atas pasir, berselimut kanvas
Abang duduk kat beranda, jala atas riba
Aku duduk depan kek tenun, benang emas satu-satu

[Chorus]
Hujan atas atap zink
Abang sirat, aku tenun
Tak siapa bercakap
Tapi dua-dua tak nak bangun

[Verse 2]
Jala tu dah elok, abang tampal lagi
Lubang kecik sebesar jari, abang kata bahaya
Aku tahu abang cuma nak duduk sebelah aku
Tiga puluh tahun, laut ambil abang separuh tahun

[Bridge - gamelan thins to gambang and voice]
Bila angin berubah, abang turun ke laut
Aku simpan bunyi jala ni dalam kepala

[Chorus]
Hujan atas atap zink
Abang sirat, aku tenun
Songket ni siap bulan tiga
Abang pun naik perahu bulan tiga

[Outro - the gong cycle closes]
Hujan lagi, abang
Duduk lagi
